title: English Practice Quiz 0378
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: How ___ apples do you need?
questions.explanation: Apples are countable plural nouns, so use many.

questions.question: I ___ him last week.
questions.explanation: Use the past simple with a finished past time such as last week.

questions.question: Choose the correct plural of 'child'.
questions.explanation: Children is the irregular plural of child.

questions.question: Choose the correctly written date phrase.
questions.explanation: Days of the week begin with a capital letter.

questions.question: I enjoy ___ books.
questions.explanation: Enjoy is followed by a gerund (-ing form).

questions.question: Choose the correct word: Please ___ the details.
questions.explanation: Confirm means to check or establish that something is correct.

questions.question: Which word has the /ʃ/ sound as in 'ship'?
If she studies, she ___ the test.
questions.explanation: Use will + base verb in the main clause of the first conditional.

questions.question: Choose the correct sentence.
questions.explanation: After doesn't, use the base form of the verb: like.

questions.question: The meeting starts ___ 9 a.m.
questions.explanation: Use at for a specific clock time.
